final: WITH g AS (SELECT si.riskeval AS rk, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS ga FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.riskeval), o AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS oa FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.ga) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(g.ga - o.oa) AS avg_diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE g.ga > o.oa
